layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Apex predator diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish marine reptile flipper-paddle bone made of smooth clay
The item is a clean white clay bone with a stylized, thick slab-meat border of deep dark-crimson clay surrounding it
Smooth, chunky profile with rounded contours to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay marine-meat cut sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate an apex diet of larger marine animals for a children's matching game. No text.
